story.iWant: to search for customers by name, email, or phone with pagination
story.soThat: I can quickly find customers in the system
story.tasks: - Task 1: Implement GET endpoint in CustomerController (AC: #1, #2) - Task 2: Create SearchCriteria DTO (AC: #2) - Task 3: Create PagedResponse DTO (AC: #3) - Task 4: Implement search logic with multi-field filtering (AC: #2, #4) - Task 5: Implement sorting and pagination (AC: #2, #10) - Task 6: Implement pagination validation and limits (AC: #8, #9) - Task 7: Optimize database queries with indexes (AC: #5, #6) - Task 8: Implement audit logging for search operations (AC: #7) - Task 9: Integration tests for search/pagination (AC: #1-10)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. GET /api/v1/customers endpoint with query parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination 2. Query parameters: query (searches firstName, lastName, email, phone), status (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), limit (default 50, max 100), offset (default 0), sortBy (default "lastName"), sortOrder (default "ASC") 3. Returns 200 OK with paginated response: data array, pagination metadata (limit, offset, total, hasMore) 4. Empty results return 200 OK with empty data array 5. Performance: response < 500ms for large datasets (1M+ customers) 6. Database query uses indexed columns (email, phone, lastName) 7. Audit entry created for search operations 8. Limit enforced (max 100) 9. Offset must be non-negative 10. Results sorted by specified field

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR002: Search and retrieve customer by ID, name, email, or phone with pagination. NFR001: Performance < 500ms for typical operations.

doc.title: Story 2.1: Customer Domain Model
doc.snippet: Story 2.1 created indexes on email, phone, status, createdAt for search performance. Story 2.4 relies on these indexes for multi-field search.

artifact.reason: Use findByLastNameContainingIgnoreCase() and add custom @Query methods for multi-field search with pagination.

story-context.constraints: - Max limit: 100 (prevent resource exhaustion) - Offset must be non-negative - Multi-field search: firstName OR lastName OR email OR phone (case-insensitive substring match) - AND logic for combining query with status filter - Response time < 500ms for large datasets (1M+ customers) - Use indexed columns for WHERE clauses - Empty results return 200 OK (not error) - Story 2.3 must be completed (CustomerController exists)

PagedResponse DTO

tests.standards: Testing standards require multi-field search tests, pagination tests, performance tests for large datasets. Use JUnit 5, MockMvc, Testcontainers. Verify indexed columns used via EXPLAIN PLAN.
tests.ideas: AC1: Controller test - GET /api/v1/customers with query parameters, verify endpoint mapping AC2: Service test - Search with query="smith", verify matches firstName/lastName/email/phone containing "smith" (case-insensitive) AC3: Service test - Verify PagedResponse includes data, limit, offset, total, hasMore fields AC4: Service test - Search with no results, verify 200 OK with empty data array AC5: Performance test - Search on 1M+ customer dataset, verify response < 500ms AC6: Integration test - Verify database uses indexes (EXPLAIN PLAN shows idx_customer_email, idx_customer_phone, idx_customer_lastName) AC7: Service test - Verify auditService called with operation=SEARCH AC8: Controller test - Request limit=200, verify capped at 100 AC9: Controller test - Request offset=-1, verify 400 Bad Request AC10: Service test - Verify results sorted by sortBy field in sortOrder direction
